bullets.text: Minister Dr. K.G. Arunraj stated that TVK candidates are certain to win the by-election, and our office should monitor political reactions.
Power supply will be suspended in Thillai Ganga Nagar from 9 am to 2 pm, and the constituency team should assist residents if needed.
The Tiruvallur district administration strengthened surveillance on paddy movement after traders brought bags to DPCs, and our team must watch developments.
Chennai-Arakkonam train delays of up to 30 minutes persist despite yard upgrades, and the district team should track commuter grievances.
Telangana IT Minister D. Sridhar Babu pitched a global capability centre hub and skill-centric curricula, so our portfolio team should review similar initiatives.

takeaways: Tiruvallur administration stepped up checks at direct procurement centres to stop trader exploitation.
Farmers complained that outside traders were unfairly dumping paddy bags into state procurement channels.

stories.title: Chennai–Arakkonam Train Delays Persist After Yard Upgrade

Commuters face continued inconvenience despite the completion of a ninety-seven crore yard remodelling project.
